articles.summary: PM Anwar Ibrahim warned all parties against dragging Negeri Sembilan's royal institution into campaigning ahead of the Aug 1 state election. Polling day is Aug 1, with nomination day on July 18 and early voting July 28; PH has finalised its 36-seat allocation (PKR 16, DAP 11, Amanah 9).
articles.title: Don't drag royals into Negeri Sembilan polls, Anwar tells parties

articles.summary: Pakatan Harapan chairman Anwar Ibrahim announced the coalition's full slate of candidates for the Negeri Sembilan state election, with PH campaigning on its governance record. The contest comes amid an ongoing royal succession dispute in the state that began in April 2026.
articles.title: Anwar to unveil PH candidates for Negeri Sembilan polls

articles.summary: The Ministry of Natural Resources and Environmental Sustainability launched the National Carbon Market Policy (NCMP), setting up a carbon-credit trading framework ahead of a planned carbon tax. Minister Arthur Joseph Kurup said a carbon tax would be premature without a functioning carbon market first.
articles.title: National Carbon Market Policy launched to guide Malaysia's carbon market ecosystem

articles.summary: Greenpeace Malaysia criticised Budget 2026 for making only incremental climate commitments. The budget raised the Ecological Fiscal Transfer to RM250 million (from RM200 million) for state-level biodiversity conservation, alongside renewable energy, rail transport and forestry measures.
articles.title: Incremental progress on Budget 2026 climate ambitions not enough

articles.summary: From June 1, 2026, Malaysia doubled the minimum monthly salary for Category I Employment Pass holders to RM20,000, with Category II set at RM10,000-19,999 and Category III at RM5,000-9,999, reshaping how employers hire and compensate foreign professionals.
articles.title: Malaysia revises expatriate Employment Pass salary policy for 2026

articles.summary: Malaysian authorities pushed back implementation of the Employment Pass succession-plan requirement to Jan 1, 2027, while transitioning employer administration from the ESD system to the new MIDA Expatriate System (MES), giving affected companies more time to comply.
articles.title: Employment Pass succession plan deferred to 2027 amid MES transition

articles.summary: Malaysia is on track to become roughly the 60th country with a dedicated Climate Change Bill, announced at the Sabah Asia-Pacific Impact Investing for Sustainable Development Summit 2026. A carbon tax is planned to follow as an incentive rather than a punitive measure for industry.
articles.title: Malaysia set to join nations with climate law

articles.summary: The UK-backed Climate Finance Accelerator Malaysia selected twelve low-carbon businesses for its 2026 cohort, spanning energy, waste and circular economy, construction, manufacturing, transport and agriculture, to help unlock investment for green projects.
articles.title: Climate Finance Accelerator Malaysia unveils its 2026 cohort

articles.summary: The International Greentech & Eco Products Exhibition (IGEM) 2026 will run Oct 7-9 under the theme 'Race Towards Net Zero: Action Beyond Boundaries', bringing together sustainability stakeholders alongside the KL SDG Summit.
articles.title: IGEM 2026 and KLSS 2026 set the stage for Malaysia's next wave of green growth

articles.summary: Malaysia is formally institutionalising its National AI Office (NAIO) on July 28 as the central body coordinating national AI strategy and governance. The Digital Ministry plans to launch a National AI Action Plan 2026-2030 in Q3, targeting 30,000 trained AI professionals by 2030.
articles.title: Malaysia's National AI Office to be institutionalised on July 28

articles.summary: The Malaysia Agentic AI Forum (MAAF) was held in Kuala Lumpur on July 15, bringing together enterprise leaders, regulators, investors and system integrators. Discussion centred on moving Malaysian organisations from generative-AI pilots to production-grade autonomous AI delivering measurable ROI.
articles.title: Malaysia Agentic AI Forum convenes enterprise leaders in Kuala Lumpur

articles.summary: July 2026 saw a cluster of major model releases — OpenAI's GPT-5.6 line, xAI's Grok 4.5 and Meta's Muse Spark 1.1 — intensifying competition on price and agentic capabilities, including long-context and computer-use features. The releases pushed input/output token pricing sharply lower across providers.
articles.title: New frontier model wave triggers AI price war
